unsupported: Wallace Woodworks Artisans LLC was founded in 1982 by Jeff Wallace in South Salt Lake, Utah.
The shop began as a one-man operation and grew through word-of-mouth referrals into a team of craftsmen producing custom woodwork for clients across the United States.
Projects are designed in-house and fabricated using traditional joinery and modern woodworking equipment, with each piece tailored to the client’s specifications.
Wallace Woodworks serves residential homeowners, interior designers, architects, and builders.
The firm’s portfolio shows work in both new construction and renovation contexts.

Known for: Custom bespoke woodwork tailored to each client’s design; In-house design and fabrication from concept to installation; Reputation built on word-of-mouth referrals since 1982; Use of premium materials and traditional joinery methods; Nationwide project capability with a local Utah workshop
